title: bernooi/shared_sumstats pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the samplesheet provided with params.input

id.errorMessage: Sample/trait id is required and must not contain spaces

sumstats.errorMessage: Sumstats must be a path to a .tsv/.txt/.out or gzipped variant

format.errorMessage: Format must be one of: gwas-ssf, gwama, hail, hail_step3, cvdkp, cc_mtag

n.errorMessage: Sample size (n) must be a positive integer

ancestry.errorMessage: Ancestry must be one of: EUR, EAS, SAS, AFR, AMR, MIX

pop_prev.errorMessage: Population prevalence (pop_prev) must be a number between 0 and 1; leave blank for quantitative traits

samp_prev.errorMessage: Sample prevalence (samp_prev) must be a number between 0 and 1; leave blank for quantitative traits. Case fraction in this trait's own GWAS sample -- pair with pop_prev for LDSC liability-scale h2.

build.errorMessage: build must be GRCh37 or GRCh38; leave blank to inherit --genome_build
